text:
Heather’s Live Painting was the perfect unique touch to our wedding day and it made for such great "Atmosphere Entertainment" for the guests! Our guests fell in love watching Heather, and loved seeing the details she continued to add throughout the event.
From our first consultation, with Heather, to the delivery, she was everything we could have asked for and more. I had no idea what moment I wanted Heather to paint, how I wanted the painting to look, etc. After talking through details, Heather made quick sketches during the phone consultation and texted her sketches to me and my husband to view. It was so neat how she was helping us visualize the painting in advance with these sketches. A TRUE talent!
Heather captured our first dance, and the painting came out absolutely beautiful, and it is hanging front and center in our home. We had Heather ship our painting, and I want to add, that my husband and I appreciated that she even thought to add the hanging material to the back of the painting. It's all about the details with Heather!
Highly recommend Heather for your event. Having this painting in our home is something we will cherish for the rest of our lives, and we love reliving our first dance moment through this painting everyday.

Thank you so much Heather!

owner_reply.text: Rachele, this brings be so much joy that you loved your experience and painting so much!! I am so honored to have painted at your wedding. Thank you very much for having me!
